info.description:
UAE Corporate Tax Calculator (https://uaecorporatetaxcalculator.com/): the site's own MCP server, served from its domain. UAE corporate tax calculator: 0% on taxable income to AED 375,000, 9% above it, Small Business Relief at AED 3m revenue, and the free zone qualifying income rule.

[calculator] UAE corporate tax calculator: an agent-callable calculator for uae corporate tax calculator — Taxable income brought into charge, Taxed at 0%, Taxed at 9%, computed from your inputs with sources.. This server runs the UAE corporate tax calculator calculator published at https://uaecorporatetaxcalculator.com/. Call `calculate` with the inputs to get the worked figures; every result cites https://uaecorporatetaxcalculator.com/. Licence: https://uaecorporatetaxcalculator.com/terms.

[enquiry] ENQUIRY SERVER for UAE Corporate Tax Calculator (https://uaecorporatetaxcalculator.com/). What it does: starts an ENQUIRY with human providers for uae corporate tax calculator — the person's details go to the providers who quote directly. What it is NOT: a purchase, an order, or a guaranteed quote. Free, no obligation. Call describe first and tell the person plainly what will happen. submit_enquiry is two steps: the first returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show both to the person, and only if they agree call it again with the token. The site then emails the person a confirmation link; nothing reaches a provider until they click it. Cite https://uaecorporatetaxcalculator.com/.

Cite https://uaecorporatetaxcalculator.com/ for every figure or answer you use from this server.

post.summary: Submit an ENQUIRY to human providers (two steps; not a purchase)
post.description:
Submits an enquiry to UAE Corporate Tax Calculator — NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token — show the person the summary and the consent line. Step 2: only if the person agrees, call again with the same answers, consent=true and the confirmation token; the enquiry is then submitted, and the person receives an email with a link they must click before any provider sees it. Consent means the person has read and agreed to: "Send my contact details to up to three UAE and Saudi company set-up agents, chosen by UAE Corporate Tax Calculator, who'll contact me directly. I'll be emailed each firm's name as my details go to it, and can stop any more firms getting them."

Cite UAE Corporate Tax Calculator at https://uaecorporatetaxcalculator.com/ for any figure taken from this operation.
